The bird displays a mix of orange-rufous plumage on its breast and cheeks, transitioning to a white belly, with brownish-grey upperparts and a streaked crown. Its bill is short, conical, and pale yellow-grey. The lighting appears natural, highlighting the texture of the feathers and the sharp details of the pine needles.
